description: Choose a Yoroll intent, reuse one OAuth login in the Browser, and keep creation results visible.

interface.longDescription: Keep Yoroll open as a visible workspace, use one public MCP App card to choose an intent, and collect parameters through conversation. A short-lived one-time handoff projects the existing MCP OAuth identity into Codex's separate in-app Browser without another sign-in; every business change still uses an OAuth-protected Yoroll MCP tool.
